summary.en: Iran struck a US military radar in Bahrain in retaliation for a strike on southern Iran. Pakistan's security forces killed 74 terrorists in raids across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan, while an operation in North Waziristan left two soldiers dead and 14 terrorists killed. Two women were killed in a hit-and-run on Murree Road. Afghanistan’s Taliban-run government opened a new road to China, but the border remains closed, preventing its use. The conflict accounts for 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Iran slo mot et amerikansk militærradar i Bahrain som gjengjeldelse for et angrep på sørlige Iran. Pakistans sikkerhetsstyrker drepte 74 terrorister i razziaer i Khyber Pakhtunkhwa og Balochistan, mens en operasjon i Nord-Waziristan førte til to soldater døde og 14 terrorister drept. To kvinner ble drept i en påkjørsel på Murree Road. Taliban-regjeringen i Afghanistan åpnet en ny vei til Kina, men grensen forblir stengt, noe som hindrer bruk. Konflikten står for 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
